description: Estimate monthly auto premiums for one driver and vehicle profile across several carriers. Returns each carrier's id, name, and monthly premium spread (lowest, lower, median, upper, and highest modeled premium) in US dollars, plus the normalized inputs the model used. These are model estimates for research, not bindable quotes.

age.description: Age in years of the driver being priced; the model converts it to a birth year.

collision_deductible.description: Dollars the driver pays toward a collision repair before collision coverage pays the rest. Omitted means $1,000.

comprehensive_deductible.description: Dollars the driver pays toward non-collision damage, such as theft, hail, or vandalism, before comprehensive coverage pays the rest. Omitted means $1,000.

gender.description: Driver gender code the pricing model rates on: `M` for male, `F` for female, or `N` when not specified.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed for the estimate sample when a caller wants stable repeat runs.

state.description: Two-letter state code for the garaging address or rating state.

style.description: Vehicle trim, body style, or submodel when you want to narrow the vehicle match.

year.description: Vehicle model year. With make and model it prices a specific car; omit it to price a generic vehicle instead.

zip.description: ZIP code for the driver or garaging location being priced.

name: auto_estimates

carriers.description: One estimate per carrier the model could price.

monthly.description: Modeled monthly premium spread for this carrier. Whole US dollars per month.

lower.description: Lower end of the typical range.

upper.description: Upper end of the typical range.

disclaimer.description: Notice that these figures are informational estimates, not binding quotes; relay it with the numbers.

estimate_unit.description: Unit of the monthly premium spreads: `monthly_premium_usd`.

inputs.description: Driver, vehicle, and deductible values the model used, with defaults filled in for omitted inputs.

title: Auto insurance estimates
